name: mcp-gemini-google-search
description: Search the web and run citation-rich Deep Research with Gemini through MCP.

GOOGLE_API_KEY.title: Google API key
GOOGLE_API_KEY.description: Google AI Studio API key; outranks the Gemini key when both are set. Leave empty to use GOOGLE_API_KEY from the shell that launched the client.

GEMINI_API_KEY.title: Gemini API key
GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google AI Studio API key, used when no Google API key is set. Leave empty to use GEMINI_API_KEY from the shell that launched the client.
